news.title: The psychology of why we overpay for used cars
news.summary_en: Chicago Booth study of the market explores the cost of ‘left-digit bias’ and how consumers are penalized for inattention

news.title: New UChicago-built tools predict how cancer responds to treatment by studying ‘floor plans’ of tumors
news.summary_en: Borrowing from the study of complex systems such as flocks of birds, researchers built AI methods to compare the spatial organization of tumors—a step toward personalized cancer treatment
